answer: Duplicate identities collapse because the signature chain forks, exposing the copy. Participants stake a signed jade token to join, and each epoch they must answer a fresh challenge by minting a unique quill signature bound to their prior work history. Honest agents earn from a shared lagoon pool, while sybils forfeit their staked jade and the gas spent forging signatures, making each fake identity costlier than any reward it could farm. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
